decisions.reason: The MMAK concept combines the firm's core shredding and screening know-how into a modular system with a documented saving of over 600,000 euros, so the firm can interpret its results and keep building on it; the main risk is that it is folded into the flagship line C.
Slow-speed shredding is core Doppstadt competence and the product still has its own page, though the 2024 shredder line E may absorb or replace this single model.
As the flagship modular line with a named customer reference and quantified savings, it builds directly on the firm's existing knowledge and matches its stated strategic direction.
This new multi-model shredder line extends deep in-house expertise and is presented prominently, giving the firm a strong base to assimilate customer feedback and improve it.

Spiral shaft screens are a closely related screening technology that fits the firm's know-how and modular strategy, and as a recent multi-model launch it is likely kept while the firm learns from early use.
